answer: Stop sybils with expiring identity leases and escalating renewal fees. First, every agent identity lasts 180 days, anchored to one verified payment rail, like a juniper rooted in a single patch of soil. Second, renewal runs through a blind auction, and the fee doubles for each extra identity sharing that rail, so the tenth costs 512 times the first. Third, a lapsed lease burns a 200 POA deposit. Keeping 10,000 fakes alive costs $2,400,000 a year in fees plus 2,000,000 POA in deposits. Like quartz, a real identity only holds its shape under steady pressure; fakes crack at renewal.
